newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mayor's security chief killed in south Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Mayor's security chief killed in south Philippines.

text.p: The chief security officer of a southern Philippine mayor was gunned down in a late night ambush, police said on Thursday.
Two unidentified men pumped eight bullets into police officer Bienvenido Lopez on Wednesday while he was riding his motorcycle home, local precinct commander Saiben Akmad told reporters.
Lopez is the chief security officer of mayor Ludovico Badoy of Cotabato city, which is 880 km (546 miles) south of Manila.
Lopez's wife, who was riding with him, survived despite suffering gunshot wounds in the attack. She was in critical condition in a local hospital.
Badoy has ordered a city-wide manhunt on the two assailants, who fled by foot into the nearby marshland.
Police declined to give any motive for the killing.
